title: T203 · RAROC Loan Pricing Model
description: Model risk-adjusted return on capital for loan pricing. Inputs: loan amount, margin, fees, cost of funds, expected loss (from T198), capital allocation (from T201), and operating cost. Outputs RAROC, economic profit/loss, minimum margin for target RAROC, and Policy Mandate JSON loan pricing record. Client-side. Zero PII.
